name: Lower Big Creek
about: Lower Big Creek drains about 21 square miles, 24% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 670 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 440 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Big Creek and Sand Run. It includes part of Flint Hill. Downstream, its water flows into the Cuivre River, which empties into the Mississippi River.
